'''Purple aliens''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species with long necks and an indestructible outer skin.<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref> A number of these aliens could be found in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref>, wielding their signature long range [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons.<ref name="Hint Book" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although unnamed in [[1991]]'s [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] and its manual,<ref name="SWNES" /> these aliens were identified in the ''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''.<ref name="Hint Book" />
